gaps.sentence: He wishes he ___ his temper in the meeting yesterday.
gaps.hint: past regret with wish plus past perfect
gaps.explanation: Regret about past behavior takes the past perfect: had not lost.

gaps.sentence: I wish the meeting ___ tomorrow; I would rather sleep in.
gaps.hint: a wish about a present arrangement
gaps.explanation: Wishes about present facts use 'were': were not.

gaps.sentence: You will not pass the course unless you ___ all the assignments.
gaps.hint: unless means if not, present simple
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' introduces a negative condition and takes the present simple: complete.

gaps.sentence: If people ___ less time on their phones, they would read more.
gaps.explanation: An unreal present habit takes the past simple in the if-clause: spent.

gaps.sentence: If he ___ so stubborn, we would have reached an agreement by now.
gaps.hint: present cause with a result up to now
gaps.explanation: An unreal present cause can produce a result reaching into the past; formally 'were' is used: were not.

gaps.sentence: If the pilot ___ the storm, we would have landed on time.
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition takes the past perfect: had avoided.

gaps.sentence: Would you ___ me if I told you a secret?
gaps.hint: would plus infinitive in result clause
gaps.explanation: The result clause of a second conditional uses 'would' plus the infinitive: forgive.

gaps.sentence: If you had watered the plants, they ___.
gaps.hint: negative unreal past result with would
gaps.explanation: The unreal past result takes 'would not have' plus the past participle: would not have died.
